question: What do the incidents on Serper's status page between 2026-08 and 2026-10 say for the record's reliability note?
why: serper.betteruptime.com lists degraded periods from 2026-08 to 2026-10. Its incident pages state that repeated non-generic queries sent within a short time window see higher latency due to changes by Google (incident of 2026-08-07, resolved 2026-08-10), and that from 2026-10-30 results 4 to 10 came back as google.com/goto links that resolve about 30 seconds after the search, until real URLs returned on 2026-10-31 (stated as likely temporary). The record's reliability note states no event.
